Thestandard covers the following types of brazing alloys:a) Aluminium-silicon alloys,b) Copper-and-copper-zinc alloys,c) Copper-phosphorus alloys,d) Copper-silver alloys,e) Copper-gold alloys,f) Magnesium-aluminium alloys,g) Heat-resisting brazing alloys,h) Palladium brazing alloys, andj) Alloys for vacuum brazing.2 ReferencesIS 2 :1960Rules for rounding offnumerical valuesIS 24 :1950Specification for brazingsolderIS 192 : 1956Specification for silver solderIS 460 : 1962 Specification for test sievesIS 737 : 1965Specification for wrought aluminium and aluminium alloys,drawn tube (for general engineering purposes)IS 812 : 1957Glossary of terms relating to welding and cutting ofmetalsIS 1387 : 1967General requirements for the supply of metallurgicalmaterials
